handoff.summary: Commits 2ac87d57 and e51b0957 add immutable Plotly-native axis, scene, legend, and annotation settings; one pure PlotSpec-to-Plotly lowering entry point for semantic and raw fallback layers; deterministic 2D panel domains and stable qualified layer identities without repeated coordinate copies; coordinated theme-default lowering; a checked presentation contract; and CPython/Sage.js differential and performance tests.
risks: The three new strict modules add 55026 source bytes, so the existing plot-spec 100000-byte package budget is exceeded by 4983 bytes on this lane; central integration must split or deliberately raise the lazy budget alongside the concurrent theme and curve modules.

The canonical theme module was developed concurrently and is not present at this lane's base; the lowering contract was coordinated against its committed public API but needs one combined integration run.
Panel lowering intentionally rejects domain traces, nonlocal nested axis references, and raw layers that expand to multiple traces when stable one-layer/one-trace identity cannot be inferred.
next_steps: Add axes.py, composition.py, and lowering.py to pyrightconfig.json and export the selected public names from sagejs.plotting.__init__.
Register test/plot-axes-composition.cjs in the integration manifest and account for the plotting lazy-source budget.

After the semantic Graphics and theme commits land, route Graphics.plotly() and Graphics3d.plotly() through lower_plot_spec and verify exact legacy layout/config parity plus theme-first merge behavior.
